title: checkout-api latency spike and ECS restart loop
summary: p99 latency on checkout-api rose from ~80ms to over 4s over 12 minutes, with ECS tasks restarting repeatedly. On-call rolled back the most recent deploy first; latency did not improve. Root cause was eventually traced to RDS connection pool exhaustion caused by a separate batch job holding long-lived connections.
resolution: Killed the long-lived batch job connections, added a query timeout to the batch job, added a CloudWatch alarm on DatabaseConnections approaching max_connections.
lesson: A rollback was tried first and did not help, because the cause was a shared downstream dependency, not the deployed code. Check downstream dependency saturation before rolling back.

title: Planned RDS Multi-AZ failover mistaken for outage
summary: A 90-second connection error burst coincided with an RDS maintenance-window failover. The on-call engineer paged the secondary on-call before checking the RDS event history, which showed the failover was planned maintenance.
resolution: No action needed beyond confirming application reconnect behavior was correct.
lesson: Check RDS event history for planned maintenance failovers before escalating further.

title: Fleet-wide EKS node disk pressure after log shipper regression
summary: A log-shipper DaemonSet update stopped rotating logs correctly. Multiple nodes across the cluster hit DiskPressure within a few hours of each other, causing cascading pod evictions.
resolution: Rolled back the log-shipper DaemonSet to the previous version, manually cleared accumulated logs from affected nodes, added a disk-usage alarm at the node level.
lesson: When DiskPressure hits more than one node in a short window, suspect a fleet-wide configuration change rather than a single noisy workload.

title: Public API outage from expired imported TLS certificate
summary: An imported (non-ACM-managed) certificate on a public ALB listener expired without warning, causing TLS handshake failures for all clients. No expiry alarm existed for imported certificates.
resolution: Issued an emergency replacement certificate, migrated to an ACM DNS-validated certificate going forward, added a DaysToExpiry alarm.
lesson: Imported certificates do not auto-renew. They need their own expiry alarm; assuming ACM handles all certificates uniformly was the root mistake.
